title: Account Identity and Staff Access
outcome: Authenticated NoorPath customer, operator and platform accounts expose a safe signed-in member name with reachable account, settings, help and logout actions, while the public customer experience provides a temporary staff login route without changing identity policy or moving staff workspaces.
actor: Authenticated customers, approved operator members, Platform Administrators, and public visitors who need to find the current staff sign-in entry.
modules: Accounts remains authoritative for authenticated account identity and session establishment.
Operators remains authoritative for operator membership, operator display name and permissions.
Web owns shared account-menu presentation and the temporary public staff sign-in link.
Auth0 remains the configured session provider; this slice does not introduce a new authentication method or identity store.
routes: Public customer page -> Sign in or existing customer navigation
Authenticated customer header -> account menu -> My account, Settings, Help, Log out
Public customer footer -> Operator / Admin login -> existing secure sign-in -> operator route
Approved operator workspace -> named account menu -> operator account, settings, support, logout
Platform Administrator protected shell -> named account menu -> admin account context, help, logout
acceptance: Authenticated customer account chrome displays a safe member display name when the identity provider supplies one, with a calm fallback when it does not.
Approved operator account chrome displays the signed-in member name separately from the operator business display name.
Platform Administrator protected account chrome exposes the same account-menu pattern.
Account menus provide reachable My account, Settings, Help and Log out actions without dead links.
Logout uses the existing Auth0 session boundary and safely returns to NoorPath; browser code never receives provider secrets or tokens.
The public customer footer exposes a temporary Operator / Admin login entry that returns staff users to the existing operator route after authentication.
No staff portal subdomain migration, permission broadening, phone OTP activation or profile-preference persistence is introduced.
Desktop and mobile account actions preserve NoorPath visual language, 44px targets, keyboard focus and responsive reflow.
Rendered and navigation evidence belongs to the exact unchanged implementation SHA.
exclusions: Moving operator or admin routes to portal.noorpath or another hostname.
New authentication providers, phone OTP activation or changes to Auth0 authorization policy.
Persisted customer preferences or a new settings domain.
Operator shell redesign beyond the account control needed by this slice.
Package authoring, departure operations or commercial policy changes.
